title: AC1024 block-record associative-network ownership graph admission recheck
scope: Admit only a fully reciprocal, source-bound BTR extension-dictionary path for an ACDBASSOCNETWORK, while retaining strict refusal for unqualified named-block SORTENTSTABLE and every unclosed source graph.

independentPeer.observation: The peer independently exposes the BTR extension dictionary handle, both dictionary owner handles and entries, the nested network owner/reactor, the owning root network, and the reciprocal non-owned root action.
independentPeer.limitation: LibreDWG shares lineage with this implementation; its minJSON corroborates this file's encoded relations, not general producer prevalence or associative semantics.

authority.observation: Autodesk documents a top-level network under the NOD, BTR networks physically owned by BTR extension-dictionary subdictionaries, and logical ownership/action membership by the top-level network. The source-bound rule requires this precise dictionary chain and a single reciprocal non-owned root action.
authority.limitation: These API docs establish the object-ownership arrangement, not full DWG byte semantics or support for all associative action classes.

implementation.change: Permit this nested-network profile only when the network dictionary and BTR extension dictionary have complete bounded entries, exact parent/reactor relations, a unique ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK edge, a matching block-record xDictHandle, and exactly one non-owned action from the owning root network. The cycle exception applies only to that reciprocal BTR subdictionary relation.
